subject: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@fedassess.com>, Acme Cloud Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Team / Sylvia / Acme security,

Following up on the intake from Acme and the assessor (Sylvia) — I want to centralize a short list of clarifying questions so we can avoid back-and-forth during the intake call next week. High level asks: 

1) ISO 27001 scope: Are we treating the Redwood-hosted API and Redwood Dedicated pools as in-scope but excluding customer-managed private deployments? Need confirmation from Acme on their requirement to include private deployment nodes.

2) FedRAMP readiness: Acme has asked for Low vs Moderate guidance — Sylvia, do you need any preliminary SSP artifacts or boundaries before we pick level?

3) SIG/CAIQ evidence: Acme will request CAIQ and SIG exports — what format is easiest? We have an evidence matrix in progress (attached) but need to confirm owners and sample windows (logs, backups, config snapshots).

Attachments: evidence-matrix-2026.xlsx (draft)

Action: can each of you reply with owners + a short ETA for the items below so I can send a consolidated intake to Sylvia and Acme?
- Control owners for A.5/A.6 (leadership & org controls)
- KMS/key rotation evidence and key custody policy
- Sample window for logs and backups (preferred: 30-day vs 90-day)

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@fedassess.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Thanks Grace — quick answers inline: 

- Scope: internal recommendation is to include Hosted API and Dedicated. Private (VPC/on-prem) should be "customer-managed" carve-out unless Acme is running on a Redwood-managed Dedicated node. We should confirm with Acme whether they require on-prem in-scope.

- Control owners: A.5 (Leadership) -> Marissa Cole (policy + attestation), A.6 (Org) -> Karthik Iyer (ops controls). I'll own KMS/key rotation evidence and provide the rotation schedule + HSM/KMS attestation.

- Sample windows: propose 90-day window for logs and backups for FedRAMP; 30-day is usually acceptable for SOC 2. Recommend asking Acme which they need and we can provide both if required.

I have a short KMS summary PDF and key rotation CSV I can attach — will share by Monday. Also propose a 30-minute intake slot on Monday 12/14 to run through boundaries.

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@fedassess.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Hi Grace, Irene, Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Quick intake notes from FedAssess: 

- For FedRAMP level designation we need a draft System Security Plan (SSP) boundary and a list of hosted components before we advise Low vs Moderate. If Redwood can provide an SSP excerpt with network boundaries and data flows (even a one-page diagram) that speeds up the scoping call.

- For SIG/CAIQ: the assessor team prefers a CSV export of control mappings plus any evidence links rather than an Excel workbook if you're able to provide it; both are fine. Please include assertion dates and the control owner column.

- Intake form: please upload the matrix to the intake drive (link below). We also require SOC 2 Type II period: please confirm the start/end dates if you have them, or whether you want us to treat this as a pre-audit (no SOC yet).

Intake link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-evidence-intake

Best,
Sylvia Park
FedAssess LLC

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@fedassess.com>, Acme Cloud Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Looping in a proposed evidence timeline and owners. Draft table (short):
- Policy attestations (ISO 27001): Marissa Cole — ETA 2026-12-20
- KMS & key rotation ledger: Irene Choi — ETA 2026-12-20 (Irene: thanks for offering)
- Deployment config snapshots (Dedicated pools): Karthik Iyer — ETA 2026-12-22
- Logging & backups (90d): Platform team (Karthik) — ETA 2026-12-22
- CAIQ/SIG export: Marissa -> will export CSV and add control_owner column by 2026-12-21 (attached template)

Attachment: SIG-v2-template.xlsx (I will export to CSV and push to the intake drive once owners confirm)

One outstanding ask from Acme: data residency. Acme please confirm whether US-only data is required — if so we need to lock region in the SSP.

Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Thanks team — confirming owners and a short note on deliverables from infra: 

- Deployment configs: I will run a config export job for Dedicated pools (includes kernel versions, quantization flags, and env manifests) — ETA 2026-12-22. I can also include a short README that maps filenames to control references.

- Logs: we'll prepare 90-day aggregated logs (auth, admin actions, deploy events) as compressed CSVs. Note: to protect customer data we will provide redacted artifacts and a sampling plan.

- KV cache / prefix cache evidence: we can provide a description and sampling of cache eviction events; if the assessor needs raw KV content we'll need an explicit data permit from the customer.

I'll add artifacts to the intake drive and paste links in this thread when done.

Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@fedassess.com>, Acme Cloud Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance liaison & audit prep queries

Thanks all — recap & next steps before the intake call: 

1) Scope: Hosted API + Dedicated included. Private (customer-managed) excluded unless Acme explicitly requires it. Acme: please confirm by EOD 12/19 if you need private in-scope.

2) Evidence & owners: Marissa (policies + CAIQ export) ETA 12/21; Irene (KMS rotation + attestations) ETA 12/20; Karthik (config + logs + artifacts) ETA 12/22. I'll collect and push to the intake drive.

3) FedAssess asks: please upload a one-page boundary diagram + draft SSP excerpt if possible before the call. Sylvia, can you confirm if that is sufficient for a scoping recommendation?

4) Meeting: proposed intake call Monday 2026-12-20 at 09:00 PST (30 min) — invite to follow. Please add any blocking items ASAP.

Attachments referenced: evidence-matrix-2026.xlsx, SIG-v2-template.xlsx

Thanks — I'll send a consolidated intake email to Sylvia and Acme after we get confirmations.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
